title: The Ivey League | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: 2 Blocks to Camp WaterColor with bikes, LSV, well-appointed suites, and beautiful private outdoor spaces at our classic WaterColor home - The Ivey League.
description_expanded: The Ivey League Classic WaterColor home perfectly located and comfortably decorated for up to 10 guests to enjoy a first-rate 30A vacation experience. Home Introduction Unwind in style at The Ivey League , a 3BD/ 3BA retreat in WaterColor. With easy access to Camp WaterColor, stylish interiors, and complimentary LSV, this designer home with expansive ceilings is the ideal 30A escape-just minutes from the beach access at the WaterColor Beach Club, dining, and coastal adventures. Home Highlights • 3 Complimentary Taxi Bikes • 6-Seater Low-Speed Vehicle (Golf Cart) - Complimentary access with stay (waiver required) • Outdoor Living - Lavish front porch with two seating areas plus a furnished screened-in back porch with gas grill • Sleeping for 10 Guests - 2 King Suites, Queen Guest Room, and Bunk Area on the 1st floor plus 2nd floor Loft • 1st Floor Main Living Area plus 2nd Floor Loft with lounge area for the kids • Laundry Room - On 1st Floor • Full Kitchen - Well-stocked for cooking, and features a drip and K-cup coffee maker • Dining Area seats 8 • Smart TVs with cable and WiFi • Driveway Parking for 3 Vehicles • Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay • Smart Home Security - Keyless entry at main entrance • Fireplaces are decorative only Location Perks • 2 Blocks to Camp WaterColor - enjoy multiple pools, a lazy river, waterslides, snack bar, playground, expansive park area, and a basketball court • 5 min LSV ride or bike ride to WaterColor Beach Club (beach service available) • 3 min bike ride to walking trail into Seaside • 2 min ride to the WaterColor Publix, The Perfect Pig, Pizza by the Sea, and more shopping Know Before You Go • A mid-stay clean is required for reservations 10+ nights (included in rate) • Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools included for 10 guests ages 5 and older. • Community pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available at the WaterColor Beach Club and Camp WaterColor (subject to change by the neighborhood). • Concierge available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, grocery delivery, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
